ctx.x: He continued to study and had plenty of books. After he was grown and out on his own, his first job naturally was

teaching school.
I first attended school September, 1903. My papa took me to that one room school on the back of a mule and delivered me to Professor McGowan. I breezed through all grades up to the seventh, kind of lonely because I was the only big boy in school. All the other families kept their boys home to help on the farm.
Papa wouldn't let me go to Meridian so I could finish school, so I quit that eighth grade school where I knew almost as much as the teachers.
